xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Order was received from the GST department of Maharashtra on 27th February, 2025 whereby basis the GST audit conducted by them, a demand was raised for 1502 crores, including penalty primarily on slump sale of Pharma Business in FY 2020-21
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeal was filed before Joint Commissioner (Appeals). Hon’ble GST Appellate Authority has, vide its Order dated 29th May, 2025, passed a favorable judgement where the earlier tax demand, including penalty, imposed upon the Company was reduced from Rs.1,502 crore to Rs. 9.22 crore.
